claims.statement: A semisimple complex operator whose characteristic polynomial divides (X-1)^m is the identity.
claims.proof: Its squarefree minimal polynomial divides a power of X-1, hence divides X-1.

claims.statement: Source TmW y implies IsTameWD y.
claims.proof: The two wild-inertia valuation conditions agree after division by the nonzero valuation of the argument; inePol equals charPol on Weil elements. Apply semisimple-triviality to every wild-inertia element.

claims.status: proved under stated full LLC laws
claims.statement: For any Tor y there is z with R(z)=y and Good z.
claims.proof: Choose z by surjectivity. For every cuspidal-support factor u, Laws.supp gives divisibility of its Weil characteristic polynomial on commutators by (X-1)^dim(y). Semisimplicity kills all commutators. Laws.cusp gives irreducibility, so the commutative image has dimension one. Laws.dim gives rank(u)=1. Thus z is Toral and Good.

claims.status: proved under stated full LLC laws
claims.statement: If the local field is continuously isomorphic to Q_p and TmW y, there is z with R(z)=y and Good z.
claims.proof: Choose z by surjectivity. TmW implies IsTameWD. The reverse direction of full Laws.depth gives nonzero KOne fixed vectors; good_of_fixed gives Good over Q_p.

claims.status: proved under IsRecT for R and restricted uniqueness
claims.statement: If r satisfies IsRecT and r(x)=y with Tor y or (Q_p local field and TmW y), then r(x)=R(x).
claims.proof: Choose the Good preimage z. Restricted uniqueness gives r(z)=R(z)=y=r(x); weak injectivity with Good target z gives x=z.

claims.statement: Both Row0b guards and the older NcW guard lie in the union covered above.
claims.proof: The toral branch gives Tor directly. IsQpBig implies the required Q_p isomorphism, and the tame branch includes TmW. OfStar.star_guard sends NcW into these cases. The unguarded dimension clause uses dimension laws separately and does not require full parameter equality.
